title: 历史白鹭命名与接口静态研究摘要

scope.sourceScope: Eight selected historical engine source files and previously saved EUI static evidence; no extraction, execution, build or performance measurement.
scope.retainedStyle: Keep familiar class names, display-list organization, image/text/animation vocabulary, PascalCase types and camelCase members.
scope.modernDirection: Modernize module boundaries, explicit ownership, typed events, resource leases, lifecycle, schema versions and diagnostics; keep legacy compatibility isolated and test semantics.
scope.versionBoundary: All proposed interfaces are candidates. Exact old-version compatibility and production performance are unverified.
scope.criticalCorrection: Width/height behavior differs by version/subclass; selected snapshot uses explicit dimensions or original bounds.

observations.fact: Classes use PascalCase and public members use camelCase; namespace egret appears in the eight chosen files.
Sprite is a DisplayObjectContainer with graphics; Bitmap is a DisplayObject with a Texture property.
The selected DisplayObject snapshot reads width/height from explicit values or original bounds; its setters assign explicit values, not scaleX/scaleY directly.
observations.limitation: Do not generalize to other archived subtrees, versions or subclasses.

observations.fact: Listener registration has thisObject, capture and priority; registration returns void; once is a separate method; removal compares listener and thisObject in a capture-specific table.
Event notification calls listeners before once-list removal; dispatchEventWith obtains and releases pooled Event objects.
observations.limitation: Reentrant and mutation behavior has not been executed or proven compatible.

observations.fact: removeChild processing detaches parent/stage links and returns the same child; selected path does not implement a terminal disposal operation.
TouchEvent exposes TOUCH_BEGIN/END/CANCEL/TAP constants, stage/local coordinates and touchPointID; it extends Event.
MovieClip exposes play, stop, nextFrame, prevFrame, gotoAndPlay, gotoAndStop, frame-rate and current-frame properties.
Previously saved EUI source evidence records three invalidation/validation phases and depth queues, with UIComponent, Validator, DataGroup and Skin identifiers.
observations.limitation: Existing selective static evidence, not newly read source or a runtime measurement.

observations.fact: DisplayObject and DisplayObjectContainer contain static frame and stage event lists and public/internal dollar-prefixed fields.

avoid: collapsing layout size with transformed bounds
pooled mutable public events without lifetime contract
candidateRecommendations.lifecycle: removeChild detaches; disposal is terminal and idempotent; attachment scope differs from object scope; shared assets use independent leases; GPU reclamation may be deferred.
candidateRecommendations.eventCancellation: on returns an independent subscription; cancellation is idempotent and integrates with signal; an already cancelled signal registers nothing; new once semantics remove before invoking; legacy once/reentry needs a separately tested compatibility contract.
candidateRecommendations.propagation: Display-tree events retain capture/target/bubble and cancellation; non-tree service signals are a separate semantic category.
candidateRecommendations.resourceApiBoundary: RES methods were not read in this turn. app.assets typed load/acquire is a candidate architecture suggestion, not a verified one-to-one conversion rule.

limitations: 私有原包绝对路径与源码正文不进入公开候选。
只读八个历史条目及既有EUI静态记录；没有解压、构建、执行或性能测试。
快照不是最新版本或子树共构建版本证明，尺寸/事件等须按具体版本核查。
